title: Finite candidate expectation
statement: Let $A$ be a finite set of candidates, let $a_0$ be a default element, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the candidate type. The finite candidate expectation is the uniform average of $f$ over $A$ when $A$ is nonempty, and is $f(a_0)$ when $A$ is empty.
hypotheses_covered: A default element of the candidate type
A real-valued function on the candidate type
